value.rationale: The motivating 2026 work singles out Mercedes-type frame effects and common-frame joint measurability; distinguishing compatibility from quantitative noncommutativity gives a natural structural question. This all-k classification finds every commuting pair, exact nonzero commutator spectrum, every global maximizer and the residue-class obstruction to norm 1/4, rather than reporting a sample numerical bound. The determinant/elementary-symmetric reduction is explanatory and supplies a benchmark for compatibility without commutativity. It does not assert general quantum incompatibility or results for stochastic postprocessings.
